fomod.Name: Open AddItemMenu NG - (Open DLL for SSE - AE and VR)
fomod.Author: open-additemmenu-ng contributors
fomod.Description: A new, open-source AddItemMenuSE.dll for towawot's AddItemMenu 1.14, so the original mod works again on Skyrim SE 1.5.97, AE 1.6 and 1.7, and VR. It replaces only the DLL: install the original mod first, then this one over it.
